chapter: Setting the record straight on Hendersonia
title: Rebutting claims of resentment between Horace and Fletcher
summary: Horace says he never resented Fletcher musically; their only quarrels were about Fletcher not worrying whether the band showed up. He also denies rebuffing researchers, saying he's easy to find.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I'm going to ask you something tough here maybe, and you don't have to make any comment at all.
All right.

This is also from Leonard Feather, I believe. It says, 'Although the two brothers worked together frequently, they reportedly had many differences, and Horace is widely reported as being resentful of being only as Fletcher's brother and of the fact that many arrangements popularly credited to Fletcher were in fact his own.' Do you
want to make any comment on that? In other words, the -- from --
You know... (Unintelligible).
Oh, go ahead.
This came from Leonard Feather?
I believe so, yeah.
This is the first I've ever heard of that, and I'm actually surprised, because Leonard and I are great friends, and Leonard --
I could be wrong. I just have only one page of a Xerox copy, and it --
Well, it's something -- it's there in black and white, and this is what bothers me.
Well, it could be somebody else's. It may not be the Encyclopedia. I can check this out. I don't know what the source is.
Well, the only differences, and I don't mind saying this, that Fletcher and I had didn't involve music.
There were girls, huh?
(Laughter)
Well --
No, I'm teasing.
(Laughter)
No, not girls even. I used to
bawl Fletcher out until I found out that actually he was right. I used to bawl him out, not worrying about whether the guys were going to be there on the gig, like I told you up in Massachusetts.
Right.

Now that bothered me, no end, and in fact I threatened to leave him and all this stuff, you know. These are the only differences I've had. But speaking -- but musically -- differences? I idolized that man. No way -- because he had done too much to help me in college with sending me arrangements which I could never repay him for, so somebody's off their rocker. They should have delved or checked with me and found -- we've had differences, just as I told you, but they weren't about music. No way. No way.

Well, I think that's great to clear up. It says here in the last sentence of this paragraph, "Attempts have been made to contact Horace, but he seems to rebuff attempts to discuss the old days." I would say we've sort of challenged that right here.

Yeah. Well, who has made attempts? I've been living here for the last 12 years. I have a sister that knows where I am every day in the year, so I'm not hard to find. I'm a union musician. I'm listed with the local, so somebody has --
They're making up stories.
Yes, and it's going to be cleared up.
I think that's good. That's one thing, why we're getting this stuff on tape.
Sure.
